response.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as overall_average
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  gs.death_country,
  gs.avg_points_won,
  gs.avg_points_won - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as distance_from_overall_avg
FROM group_stats gs
ORDER BY gs.death_country;

assumptions.assumption: Using player_award_vote table for award vote records, rather than manager_award_vote. The request's phrase 'award vote records matched to their players' could refer to either, but player_award_vote is the more direct interpretation.

alternatives.interpretation: Using manager_award_vote instead of player_award_vote, if manager award votes are intended by 'award vote records'.
